title: Invert emulsion: Method of preparation and application as proper formulation of entomopathogenic fungi
author: Batta

steps.title: Prepare aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Combine sterile distilled water, glycerine, and the water‑soluble emulsifier (Dehymuls K) on a weight basis to obtain the aqueous phase.

steps.title: Prepare oil phase
steps.instruction: Combine the plant‑origin oils (soybean oil and coconut oil) with the oil‑soluble emulsifier (Tween 20) on a weight basis to obtain the oil phase.

steps.title: Mix phases to form emulsion
steps.instruction: Mix the aqueous and oil phases at a 50 % w/w ratio using a homogenizer set to 20,000–25,000 rpm for 1.5 min to produce a homogeneous invert emulsion.

steps.title: Select proper formulation
steps.instruction: Prepare multiple formulations and choose the one with highest stability and lowest viscosity; for this protocol use formulation IE #4 composed of: soybean oil 28.50 % w/w, coconut oil 19.50 % w/w, Tween 20 2.0 % w/w, sterile distilled water 45.00 % w/w, glycerine 4.25 % w/w, Dehymuls K 0.75 % w/w.

steps.title: Introduce fungal conidia
steps.instruction: Add a conidial suspension of the selected entomopathogenic fungus to the aqueous phase (final emulsion still 50 % w/w each phase) ensuring a concentration of ≥1 × 10⁶ conidia mL⁻¹, then remix the two phases at 20,000–25,000 rpm for 1.5 min to obtain a homogeneous inoculated invert emulsion.

steps.title: Prepare spray application
steps.instruction: Load the inoculated invert emulsion into a small calibrated hand sprayer equipped with a low‑volume nozzle; also prepare identical volumes of a blank invert emulsion and sterile distilled water for control sprays.

steps.title: Treat insects
steps.instruction: In each container, spray the designated formulation (inoculated emulsion, blank emulsion, or water) onto the bottom, then introduce 10 adult males and females (or larvae) of the target insect species.

substeps.instruction: Cover each container with cheese‑cloth mesh fastened with a rubber band for ventilation.
Prepare four containers per treatment to serve as four replicates.

steps.title: Incubate and assess mortality
steps.instruction: Incubate the containers at 25 ± 1 °C for 7–10 days, then record insect mortality.

substeps.instruction: Calculate mean % mortality for each treatment.
Analyze data using ANOVA followed by Duncan’s Multiple Range Test or Tukey’s HSD to compare formulated strain, unformulated conidial suspension, blank formulation, and untreated control.
